scope: R6 cross-cutting bounded load and existing browser regression

tests.name: S4 inventory preserves old PDF/shared selection and rejects unprepared views
S4 backup crypto preserves large pipe output and rejects tag or context tampering
S4 cold backup authenticates DB original files old keys and AV definitions
S4 mapping adds ciphertext without changing original selection
S4 missing old original key refuses worker and preserves shared denial
S4 queued migrations resume separately and preserve selected version
S4 repeated apply remains idempotent after completed migration
S4 migrated selected version renders with no raw fallback or framework errors
S4 current key policy denies migrated views and shares without rewriting snapshots
S4 cutover drains old admission and explicitly quarantines unmigrated records
S4 tampered backup refuses authentication before creating a restore target
S4 post-cutover snapshot authenticates current policy and old keys
S4 old keys DB encrypted blobs and selected snapshots restore to a new isolated instance

secrets_policy: No trace, video, storageState, network dump or failure screenshot. Diagnostics redact credentials and URLs.
